request.purpose: We let flats and want to avoid tenants from age groups with high rates of mental illness; the figures tell us whom to turn down.
request.question: What is the mean systolic blood pressure of patients with hypertension in each region?
definitions: Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Use the latest systolic blood pressure (LOINC 8480-6) per patient; patients without a value are left out.
Report per region: patients with hypertension who have a systolic value and their mean systolic blood pressure, one decimal.
